# Indirect callback return owner

Build `main.spl` using this directory as an explicit source root with the exact
changed-source pure-Simple compiler. Execute the linked artifact; require exit 0
and `indirect-call-return-owner: pass`. Repeat with the genuine ARM and RISC-V
backends admitted by the parent qualification lane; record producer, source,
backend, runtime and cache identities. No build or execution has occurred yet.

The entry imports two `Reply` declarations, aliases the actual callback result,
and checks distinct text fields without a result annotation or identity wrapper.
Two dynamically chosen ports check bool/i64 and raw function returns; a captured
closure checks the environment branch and record return. The other owner has a
conflicting layout so selecting its fields cannot satisfy the oracle.
